Name: Ashteroth-karnaim
Description: The place where Chedorlaomer and the kings with him smote the Rephaim in the fourteenth year, on the campaign that swept down to Sodom and took Lot captive.
BiblicalSignificance: Ashteroth-karnaim is the first battlefield of Genesis 14: giants smitten in the east before Abram ever took up arms to rescue Lot.
